recentItems.title: Heavy Rains Trap Residents, Damage Roads in Fujian
recentItems.description:
Torrential rains unleashed by Typhoon Saudel have battered Ningde in east China's Fujian Province since September 1, causing floods, trapping residents and damaging roads across the city.

Saudel, the 18th typhoon of this year, made its third landfall on the coast of Fujian on the morning of September 3.

recentItems.title: China Makes Intensive Breakthroughs in High-end Steel Products in 2026
recentItems.description:
China's steel industry has developed several breakthroughs in high-end precision materials this year, empowering the electronics, automotive and communications industries. 

To enable convenient and speedy signal transmissions, today's 5G mobile communications require ultra-thin low-carbon steel foil that's no thicker than 0.10 millimeters. 

For a long time, the rolling methods China used to achieve such thin metals relied on foreign equipment and enterprises. 

Today, the Shougang Group is mass producing a version that's even thinner at 0.07 millimeters which is expected to be used for 5G base station signal receivers, integrated circuit boards and new energy battery connection pieces. 

An engineer folded the metal into a paper airplane to demonstrate its flexibility. 

Another breakthrough has been this iron-silicon alloy widely used in drive motors for new energy vehicles and in joint motors in humanoid robots.

recentItems.title: China's Solar Power Capacity Overtakes Coal for First Time
recentItems.description:
Chinese solar power capacity has, for the first time, overtaken coal-fired power, a historic milestone in the country's energy transition. 

Data from the National Energy Administration show that, as of the end of July, installed solar capacity reached about 1.286 billion kilowatts, edging past coal at roughly 1.285 billion kilowatts. 

China now has by far the world's largest solar power base, accounting for a significant share of global installations. 

The landmark reflects the breakneck growth of renewables and China's accelerating shift toward a power system increasingly anchored in clean energy. 

At the same time, coal-fired power is evolving from the backbone of electricity generation into a supporting and stabilizing role.
